decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The accommodation shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the single family house at 33 Hartington Road and shall not be used as a separate unit of living accommodation. The rooms proposed will at no time be converted to habitable rooms.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday, and 9.30am to 12.30pm on Saturdays, and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The scheme of soft landscaping shown on the approved plans will be implemented and permanently maintained to the front courtyard of the property, to replace that which is to be lost through the insertion of the stairwell. The garden area will be equal to or greater than that which is in existence at time of approval.
description: Construction of a new basement incorporating a front lightwell to the existing house
